div.head: Iud Dei XVI 33
div.ab: Oremus. Deus, qui per ignem signa — — liberentur. Qui uiuis = Iud. Dei II 2—4, 3.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 429 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Die auf uomeres bezüglichen, Englischem Rechte widerstreitenden Worte uel pedes II 2, 6. 4, 1 lässt Co beide Male fort, ebenso fünfmal die um 1200 veralteten aquam feruentem aus II 3, 1; 3, 3; 3, 5; 4; 4, 1.

The words uel pedes II 2, 6. 4, 1, which refer to uomeres and conflict with English law, are omitted by Co both times, as, five times, are the words aquam feruentem, obsolete by 1200, from II 3, 1; 3, 3; 3, 5; 4; 4, 1.
